<finding task="2"><quote>`exclude-newer` set to the RFC 3339 timestamp of 00:00:00Z on the day after the freeze date | Every `uv run` from the repo root resolves as of the freeze date, script headers included.         return f'{self.freeze:%Y-%m-%d}T00:00:00Z'</plan><fix>Make `cutoff` return 00:00:00Z on `freeze + 1 day`. Change `test_cutoff_is_midnight_utc_on_the_freeze_date` to expect `'2026-10-20T00:00:00Z'` for 2026-10-19 and `'2027-01-01T00:00:00Z'` for 2026-12-31. <finding task="13"><quote>`build/check_jax_examples.py` and its documented command: they install `stack('jax-cpu')` in place of `--with-requirements specs/verification/32-jax-cpu.txt`.</quote><plan>uv run python build/versions.py run jax-cpu -- python build/check_jax_examples.py skills/deep-learning/</plan><fix>The R2.3 change replaces only the requirements file. The rewritten command also drops `JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu`. Keep that prefix: `JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu uv run python build/versions.py run jax-cpu -- ...`. In Task 8, make the `jax cpu examples` step of `verify_steps` set `JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu`, and add a test that asserts it. Also grep `build/check_jax_examples.py` for the retired `32-jax-cpu` path, and point it at the file in Task 12 (R6.7, "point their readers at `build/versions.toml`").</fix></finding>
<finding task="9"><quote>**Floors.** Each script's `requires-python` must match the Python floor in its `SKILL.md` `compatibility:` line.</quote><plan>- **D4** (owner, plan review, 2026-10-21): Q4. <finding task="0"><quote>Plan 63. It edits `build/run_commit_lints.sh`. <finding task="0"><quote>The plan must re-check items 2 to 6 before it relies on them.</quote><plan>## Global Constraints</plan><fix>Add the required `## Review Focus` section between Global Constraints and Decisions. Name five untested failure modes, each with a pinning test in the task where the user would see it fail. Candidates: a run from a pre-existing nested worktree; `bump` on a day that adds a package conflict; a citation phrased "and earlier" (R4.1, which names it as history form) being judged as equality; a skill script run through the `~/.claude/skills` symlink; and `drift` with no network midway through a pass.</fix></finding>
<finding task="0"><quote>R7. Tests ... The plan writes each test before its code (red, then green).</quote><plan>- [ ] **Step 3: Write the module.** Create `build/versions.py`.</plan><fix>The plan fails Self-Review check 5 (Proportion). Replace those bodies with signatures, values pinned by the spec, and test names and assertions. Keep code only for algorithms the tests do not determine, such as the citation regex and the cutoff rule.</fix></finding>
